_meta.name: stepwise
_meta.description: Stepwise regression: REG_OLS with selection stepwise and criterion bic searches the predictor subsets in both directions, adding or dropping one predictor a step while BIC improves. On survey.pulse, q4 (a value item) on the other five items keeps q5, q3 and q6 (selected_features, in the order added) and drops the service items q1 and q2. Selection buffers the request.
